title: CompanyCostOccurrence
description: A company-scoped cost's actual, already-known amount for one billing period (Phase 19, ADR-0011 backlog #13). Lives in its own table/topic rather than payment_line.v1 because a company-scoped cost belongs to no single apartment, and payment_line.v1 is keyed by apartment_id.

company_cost_occurrence_id.description: Idempotency key. Used by Flink to deduplicate on replay.

cost_definition_id.description: References a CostDefinition with scope=company. Its concept/behavior/calculation_base/recurrence/allocation rule (via cost_allocation_rules, weight_config) govern how this occurrence's amount_gross is split across apartments.

billing_period_start.description: Start of the service period this cost covers, same convention as payment_line.v1.

billing_period_end.description: End of the service period this cost covers.

amount_gross.description: Total amount for this company-wide cost, before any per-apartment split.

description.description: Free-text line as it appears on the invoice (e.g. 'Shared office rent - September 2026').
